# simpleytvideodownloader
![HitCount](https://hits.dwyl.com/darryl-land/simpleytvideodownloader.svg?style=flat-square&show=unique)

[![Download](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/70a7d9d2-11be-42e9-a629-c416b98cfa4e)](https://github.com/darryl-land/simpleytvideodownloader/releases/latest/download/Simple_YT_Video_Downloader-x86_64.AppImage)

A very very simple PyQt6 video downloader app that uses yt-dlp.
## Features
* Uses PyQt6
* Downloads video using `yt-dlp`
* Live console ouput of `yt-dlp` downloading video
* Options to enable embedding auto-generated english captions
* Installs `yt-dlp` if it is not installed

## Getting Started
Download and install the AppImage from the [Releases page](https://github.com/darryl-land/simpleytvideodownloader/releases)

Or install the dependencies required:  
* Python 3.14 or higher
* PyQt6

Then git clone and run the app
```
git clone https://github.com/darryl-land/simpleytvideodownloader.git
cd simpleytvideodownloader
python3 app.py
```
